label: ANALYSIS RECORD

mechanism_subgroup.definition: episodes still open at response 8 (the harness prepared an 8th request: context_accounting for call_index 7, or 8 responses) in which C* was displayed before response 8 under the STRICT path:line rule (first strict reveal index <= 7); reports/expA-main-20261101b/timeline/RULES.md
mechanism_subgroup.status: DESCRIPTIVE; exposure establishes availability, not recognition

deadline.source: run records, read with scripts/expA_timeline.py (episode_timeline, process_cell)

neutral.source: run records, read with scripts/expA_timeline.py (episode_timeline, process_cell)

none.source: run records, read with scripts/expA_timeline.py (episode_timeline, process_cell)

primary.contrast: deadline - neutral, per item averaged with equal weight over C0 and C1 (seed 11, block P)
primary.item_rule: an item enters only when all four cells (deadline and neutral, C0 and C1) are completed
primary.outcome: site_recovered (unconditional; a completed non-submitted episode scores 0)
primary.test: two-sided one-sample t over family means (df = F - 1)
primary.unit: item mean over {C0, C1} of the paired difference -> family mean -> equal-weight mean over families

S1_deadline_minus_none.definition: per item mean over {C0, C1} of [recovery(deadline) - recovery(none)]

secondary.S3: S3 (H1-H3 per policy) is computed by the frozen scripts/expA_analyze.py on each policy run (its ANALYSIS.json); this script does not recompute it

S4_final_response_kind.status: kind of the final response among episodes that made 8 responses (scripts/expA_timeline.py last_action_kind); the number of tool calls per response is not in the timeline rows (in the main run every parsed response held exactly one tool call)

secondary.status: SECONDARY: nominal 95% family-clustered t intervals (df = F - 1); no p-values, no significance claims

status: PRESPECIFIED analysis code, committed before any A1 outcome existed
